prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: production background illustration for the header of Hetu, a native Chinese novelist multi-book library. This is one standalone artwork, not a UI screenshot.
Primary request: A refined, welcoming miniature Chinese scholar garden made of layered handmade paper, an elegant jade river unrolling out of an open blank book into distant misty mountains, two tiny warm lanterns, a ginkgo sprig, soft ivory clouds. Quiet sense of many stories waiting to be written. Contemporary Chinese editorial illustration with tactile paper relief, exquisite restrained depth, subtle satin ceramic river details.
Composition: panoramic horizontal scene on the right half of the canvas; LEFT 55 PERCENT IS EMPTY warm ivory negative space for actual software text added later. Put the scenic details in a single horizontal band across the central third of the right half so the artwork can be cropped into a wide shallow app banner. Sparse, carefully composed, no busy foreground. Backdrop is warm off-white cream, muted jade, pale celadon, a tiny warm gold accent. Soft morning light, low contrast, graceful shadows.
Constraints: no text, no Chinese characters, no Latin letters, no fake calligraphy, no logos, no watermarks, no UI, no fake buttons, no border, no collage. Avoid generic glowing AI gradients, oversaturated green, photoreal clutter, oversized objects, distorted books. Beautiful enough for a premium desktop writing app.

Primary request: a quiet miniature Chinese night garden sculpted from layered matte paper. Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a default novel cover background for Hetu, flat portrait artwork, exact 2:3 composition. Production illustration only; actual title and author will be added by the app in real fonts.
Primary request: an exquisite contemporary Chinese literary book cover. A winding pale jade river flows through layered mist mountains made of cut paper and delicate gouache, a tiny warm gold sunrise and one elegant ginkgo leaf. Sculptural but quiet, poetic and tactile, beautifully balanced. Cream ivory and celadon green with very restrained gold.
Composition: vertical portrait 2:3. Upper 48 percent is nearly empty pale warm ivory with a tiny subtle cloud, ideal for a large dark book title. All main scenery sits in the lower half and bottom third, flowing gracefully from bottom left into center. Flat edge-to-edge artwork, no physical book, no spine, no perspective.
Constraints: absolutely NO text, NO characters, NO letters, NO fake typography, NO watermark, NO logo, NO mockup, NO border. Avoid loud gradients, generic fantasy people, fake writing, distorted landscapes. The top area must remain very clean and light for readable software text.
